data.name: Alcohol Dependence
data.description: One drink became two, two became too many, and before long you were only able to find solace at the bottom of a bottle.  God damn, you need a drink.

data.name: Amphetamine Dependence
data.description: You're not entirely sure what happened last night, but you woke up on the floor and everything has completely gone to shit.  This is not the first time this has happened to you.  With any luck, it will not be the last.

data.name: Benzodiazepine Dependence
data.description: Bars, V, xannies, whatever you called those magical sedatives, they're all gone now.  The Cataclysm would make anybody nervous, but you've heard benzo withdrawals can be lethal…

data.name: Caffeine Dependence
data.description: Caffeine gave you life and without it you are nothing.  You'd better find a steady supply, and fast.

data.name: Cannabis Dependence
data.description: Some people say marijuana isn't addictive.  For reasons you can no longer recall, you decided to prove them wrong.

data.name: Cocaine Dependence
data.description: Cocaine is indeed a hell of a drug.  One minute you're skiing down mountains of powder, the next you're rolling zombies and digging through dumpsters for crack.

data.name: Opioid Dependence
data.description: Whether by pill, pipe, or needle, you wound up chasing the dragon.  Your dealer's long dead, so you're going to need to get your fix before withdrawals set in.

data.name: Sleeping Pill Dependence
data.description: You'd been having trouble falling asleep, so you started taking prescription sleep meds.  Now you can hardly seem to fall asleep at all without them, and you'll need plenty of rest to face the days ahead.

data.name: Smoker
data.description: Cigarettes make you feel good and look cool; unfortunately, they also destroy your body, and going without is torture.  Surely you can find a pack of smokes, a vape, some chaw…anything to fight off the coming nic fit.

data.name: Boating License
data.description: You've trained in how to pilot marine craft, as well as general boating and swimming safety.

data.name: Lockpicking (Beginner)
data.description: Whether it was for fun, innocent utility, or criminal intent, you learned the basics of how to silently pick locks.  Now, being able to get into secured places just got a lot more useful.

data.name: Lockpicking (Expert)
data.description: Maybe you're a certified locksmith, a career burglar, or an intense hobbyist.  Regardless, you've spent so long picking locks you could pop most open in under a minute easy, with the right tools.

data.name: Parkour
data.description: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.

data.name: Piloting
data.description: You're probably one of the last people alive who knows how to safely operate a flying vehicle.  It remains to be seen whether you'll live long enough to make use of that skill.

data.name: Chemistry
data.description: You're acquainted with the basics of chemistry.

data.name: Archery
data.description: You've used a bow before and maybe taken a class or two.

data.name: Baseball
data.description: You used to play baseball.  Hopefully you can still remember how to use a bat when your life depends on it.

data.name: Fist Fighting
data.description: Whether at the gym or on the streets, you've had some experience with unarmed combat.

data.name: Trapping
data.description: You're experienced with setting traps and snares for small game or pests.

data.name: Electronics
data.description: You know a thing or two about working on electronics.

data.name: Arts and Crafts
data.description: You've got a fair bit of experience making odds and ends out of basic materials.

data.name: Metalworking
data.description: You know a bit about crafting things with metal, whether hot or cold.

data.name: Baking
data.description: Hours in the kitchen have taught you the ins and outs of making bread and pastries.

data.name: Cheesemaking
data.description: Making cheese is a delicate, difficult process, and you're one of the few left alive with the skills to do it.

data.name: Homebrewing
data.description: Your white lightning could knock out an elephant, but you're drinking alone now.

data.name: Bushcraft
data.description: You're proficient in a variety of core survival skills.

data.name: Sewing
data.description: You're proficient with most of the basics of making clothing and cloth goods.

data.name: Offroad Driving
data.description: Whether you're into dirtbikes, ATVs, or dune buggies, you have experience driving on terrain that isn't well-suited to wheels.

data.name: Skating
data.description: You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while riding a skateboard or wearing skates.

data.name: Swimming
data.description: At some point in your life, you learned how to swim.  Whether you still can or not is a matter of your athletics skill and the overall shape you're in.

data.name: Tabletop Gaming
data.description: As the Game Master, you've guided players' journeys through dungeons and fortresses.  Now, you're the last member of your party.

data.name: First Aid
data.description: You're trained in quickly dealing with urgent injuries.  In the absence of any medical professionals, that'll have to do.

data.name: Martial Arts
data.description: You have received some martial arts training.  You start with an unarmed martial arts style of your choosing.

data.name: Melee Style
data.description: Whether for school, ren faires, or fitness, you've learned how to handle some kind of medieval weapon.  You start with a weapon-based martial arts style of your choosing.

data.name: Handloading
data.description: You figured you could save money on ammo by learning to make your own.  Now that the factories are shut down, your abilities just went from handy to lifesaving.

data.name: Super Stun Gun
data.description: A blast of electricity from your Super Stun Gun bionic.
data.message: You discharge energy from your Super Stun Gun.

data.description: A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of your bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks and those in turn more than bashing attacks.
A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.
In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.
Extremely thin lenses provide user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.
data.//: Basically implanted contact lenses with AR capabilities

data.description: Frames along your cheekbones and eyesockets can, at a moment's notice, deploy protective lenses which seal your eyes behind polarized ballistic glass, providing protection from glare, bright flashes, physical attacks, and even environmental sources.
Largely subdermal, your skull is protected by titanium plates that provide a modicum of protection against all sorts of trauma.

Your abdominal and thoracic cavities are internally padded with thin pockets of a biocompatible gel that hardens on impact to protect your spine and organs.  While this doesn't prevent superficial injury, it should make you a bit tougher overall, at least as far as your torso is concerned.
data.//: Should conflict with anything that dramatically alters the torso's shape/internal anatomy or stuffs it full of something else.

data.description: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.
Concealed in your left arm is a single shot 12 gauge shotgun.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the shotgun.
An additional layer of tinting for the protective lenses CBM which can make the lenses dark enough to effectively blind the user when active.
Small sensors have been surgically implanted around your kidneys, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

A filtration system near your liver allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.
You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.

Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This has no impact on blunt trauma but offers a small amount of protection against cutting, stabbing, and even ballistic damage.

Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.
Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.
This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

Your nervous system is wired to a combat controller program pre-loaded with its own melee protocols.  While active, your actions in melee combat will be guided by the implant, which has above-average skill and its own martial art style, but you will not learn from this experience.

A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.
Implanted nerve stimulators grant you a +2 bonus to dexterity while this bionic is active, but a -1 penalty when it is not.

You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.
data.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's digestive organs and cannot be removed.

data.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.
A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.
A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.
When this bionic is active, you can block hearing completely.

When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.
data.//: BATEARS is better than this bionic, even if you combine the bionic with any existing hearing mutation.

data.description: Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.

A ranged EMP generator system is implanted in your right arm and the palm of your right hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.
This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.
A microcomputer wired to the thalamus that assists the brain in sorting and prioritizing sensory input.  It grants +2 perception when active, but -1 when not.
data.cant_remove_reason: The bionic is now critical to the continued functionality of the user's brain.

data.description: The eyes have been entirely replaced by a pair of implanted cameras which provide clear, high-resolution vision and come with a built-in zoom that allows the user to see long distances and treat all ranged weapons as though they had a scope.  If unpowered, the user will be completely blind.
data.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has completely replaced the patient's eyes.  Removing it would leave the patient blind.

data.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.
Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.

Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.
Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.
You can greatly intensify the power of your bionic flashlight to be much brighter at a much higher power cost.

A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light to comfortably read or craft, but it can suffice if you have nothing else.

You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

Tiny sensors implanted in your body are able to detect acute radiation syndrome through a gamma-H2AX assay, cross-checking blood cell counts to rapidly inform you of the severity of your exposure.  A separate sensor also scans your immediate environment to alert you to the presence of ionizing radiation.
Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

descriptions.text: You sense some creature moving underground here.

data.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.

Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are surgically woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.
While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.
Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.
Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence when this implant is active, and a -1 penalty when it is not.
data.cant_remove_reason: The bionic is now critical to the continued functionality of the user's brain.

data.description: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.
One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.
The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.

One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.
Your eyes are equipped with thin membranes that cover your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.
Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you forget skills you've learned slower.
data.cant_remove_reason: Removing this CBM would cause severe amnesia and neurological issues.

data.description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you the local air temperature.

Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, slowly repairing damage stopping bleeding at the cost of extra power and stored calories.  Excessive use of this CBM can depress the immune system.  No power is consumed if there is nothing to heal.
When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.
When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.
A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.
You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.

A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.
Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.
Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.

A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 100 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 250 kJ.
Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.

An advanced system of filters have been surgically implanted throughout your airway.  They provide minor protection from smoke and irritants even while unpowered, and when powered will filter out most all harmful airborne compounds.
A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.
A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.

You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your nails which can be deployed by flexing your fingers.  While active, they can be used in combat as long as you are unarmed and your fingers are not covered.
Your urinary tract is fitted with filters and reservoirs that allow your body to reclaim water from metabolic waste while this device is powered, greatly reducing your need to hydrate.
A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.
Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.
While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.
A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.

An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although you may still feel sleepy; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.

While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.

Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause fatigue.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.
Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.
Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.
Your muscules have been surgically enhanced with synthetic myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength when this implant is active and a -1 penalty when it is not.

A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.
You have highly efficient artificial lungs which greatly increase your oxygen intake.  If they are not powered you will suffocate, and they weaken your immune system somewhat.
data.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's lungs and cannot be removed.

data.description: While active, this bionic provides a visual HUD synced to sensors in your hands that greatly aid in targeting ranged weapons.
While active, a tiny device in your inner ear periodically generates ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided you are underwater and able to hear.
You have a powerful stun gun built into your hand.  Activate to attempt to zap an adjacent enemy.

This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.

At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.
Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.

Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move.  Whilst this is toggled, moving will require more effort, though more power will be generated.

Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online.  However, when it's offline it will hamper your movement, as you struggle against its moving parts.
A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.
Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.
You have a port that allows devices which can use a power bank to draw directly from your bionic power supply.
Rather than vocal cords, you speak through an electronic system which gives you what can best be described as a "creepy robot voice."
data.//: bird mutants might have an entirely different vocal chord structure rather than just a different tone of voice

data.description: You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.

Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

Titanium bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds, and you receive slightly less bashing damage to your arms, legs and torso.

A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth, and a small yet sophisticated analyzer is installed in the cavity of your skull.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.
A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants capacity to store charge.
A malfunctioning bionic attached to your digestive system causes intermittent nausea, making it difficult to keep food down.
This damaged CBM occasionally leaks radiation.
Reactive shock absorbers installed in your wrists and elbows which greatly reduce felt recoil.

A set of miniscule devices are embedded in your brain stem and hypothalamus.  When active, they allow the user to fall asleep almost instantly and at-will.  The downside, however, is that the user will remain asleep no matter what happens to their body until they complete their natural sleep cycle, unless a sleep alarm from a differet bionic device is triggered.

An implant that works on simple physics rather than electronics, this CBM replaces the ulnar collateral ligaments with assistive biocompatible tethers that automatically constrict and relax to improve the user's throwing distance and accuracy.
A powerful electromagnetic system housed in the palms which, when powered up, will expend power to greatly increasing the force of thrown magnetic objects.

In your sleep you feel verdant energy growing within you.
You dream of the hunt to end all hunts.
You are many animals, and yet one.
You swim with fish.  You fly with birds.  You run with the beasts of the land.  You change with the changing of seasons.  You are everything.
Hoof.  Talon.  Tooth.  Fight.  Feed.  Forward.
You've never felt so lithe and powerful.
After an exciting and tasty hunt, you retire to your nest.  Mmm, yes, nest.
You weave between the zombies' legs, too small for them to catch.  The gas station isn't far now, with all its soda and chips and- UGH, dream…
You dream of running down familiar streets and rooftops, mentally mapping out every escape route as you go.
You have a disturbing dream of living in a supermarket lobster tank.
Your vivid dream of living as a crustacean frightens you.
You dream of tearing into your prey, and the sweet taste of raw flesh.
You blissfully recall days spent lounging in the sun.
You dream of your legions of undead admirers, their attentions, and the wonderful pain.
You have a vivid dream of being a medical anomaly, as your heartbeat syncs with the steady drip of an IV line.
You wonder if your nest will be good enough.
You dream of cracking seeds with your beak and swallowing them dry.
Will your burrow be warm enough for the family in winter?
You dream of outrunning the apocalypse.
You have a comforting dream of swimming with a school of fish.
The thought of being out of water, forced to crawl unsupported, terrifies you.
You vividly dream of sharing a kill with your pack.
A fond memory of throating some prey animal bubbles up.
You dream of death, always at your heels, and your flesh changing to escape it.
You taste the blood of another, and know that it will be yours.
You wonder if you could find one of those 'salmon runs', or if they were just a legend…
Ah, the wolf-slaying dream again.  That's a good one…
You dream of ravens calling as you pad away from the remains of a kill.
In the dream, you fatten yourself up with all the food you can find to prepare for your next winter hibernation.
Boing!  and you've pounced another yummy critter.
You leap from rooftop to rooftop, effortlessly avoiding your pursuers while making your way to safety.
You sneak into a house, only to discover a full, intact cupboard of cat food!
You dream of the crack of bone and the taste of raw meat.
You dream of the hunt, the feed, and your pack.
Your mouth waters as you dream of eating dog food.
You howl loud and long, ecstatic after securing a whole cache of supplies.
After recruiting a new packmate, you expand your spacious den to accommodate them.
You dream of jumping the gate and leading your herd to freedom.
You dream of defending the herd from a pack of predators.
The herd moves along and you with them, finding greener pastures.
In your dreams, your fangs slip through flesh like scalpels.  You quickly crawl away to let your clumsy prey bleed out.
You flutter through the air, listening for echoes to guide you through your dream.
You dream of friends and family crowded around, chattering noisily, grooming one another, and sharing blood.
You dream of your wings carrying you through the night sky, and the comforting presence of moon and stars above.
Your sleep is utterly dreamless for a time.
You dream in smells more vivid than sight ever was.
You dream of the sun shining down on your leaves.
You dream of rotten food, decomposed until it's almost mush.
You dream of sharing your roots with a vast forest, all plants provided for as the canopy grows ever upwards.
Fire rages around you, licking at your bark and engulfing the saplings and bushes near your roots.  The once chatty forest is quiet in its wake.
You dream of communing with an ancient pine.  Trees are the true survivors of this world, it tells you.
Your vivid dream of your pseudopods calcifying into rigid structures terrifies you.
You were once many cells living as one, now you are one living as many.
You dream of being in two places at once, and four, and yet you are all a greater whole.
You dream of a vast dark ocean.  The thought of returning to it seems…undesirable.
You are acutely aware that most of you is sleeping, leaving you to contemplate your situation as you rest.
The years seem to fly past as you dream of carving great underground fastnesses.
You dream of being swaddled safe in the embrace of the soil.
You have a horrible nightmare of being caught out in the sunlight.
Mmm.  The shellfish dream again.  Yum!
You dream of recruiting a cult of fishfolk to serve your needs.
You dream of something flashing in the distant dark, and you understand every word.
You creep along, your flexile body transforming shape and color to remain hidden.
You excitedly web up an interloper and prepare to feast… nope, dream.
You relax in your web; it's not vibrating, so dinner hasn't arrived yet.
You dream of a mate, and a dance, and a mother devoured by her own young.
You startle as the shadow of a bird passes over your web, but it's only a dream.
Your fangs sink into your prey, which struggles as your many legs embrace it.
Something chases you through a maze of unfamiliar tunnels.  At last, it has you cornered, so you turn around and show it your teeth…
You lie in a pile with your brothers and sisters.  Someone keeps moving around, nearly waking you up.
Your warren is wiped out, your family lost.  It'll be OK, as long as you survive.
The world can be whole again, and only you have the courage to make it so.
You feel nothing but disgust as you dream of strangling your old self.
You dream of washing your hands and face.
You crush those who would disagree with your leadership.
You are perfect, and in your dreams, a million others just like you kneel before your superiority.
You pant, terrified at the thought of that FUNGUS destroying your home!
Your heart is moved to breaking at the thought of all the lives lost, and the struggle yet to come.
Regret haunts your dreams, for your past wrongs real or imagined.
You wish others could understand, and join your struggle…
You dream of an endless spiral you can't help but follow.
Your skin tastes the slime of another, and you follow the trail.
You dream of laying eggs in the soft soil.
Your mouth grows wider and wider, there's nothing you can't devour…
You dream of still waters, rain, and a chorus of voices raised in song.
On land and in the water, you control all that your tongue can reach.
Your body flows slightly faster than you expected… oh, just a dream.
FIGHT.  FEED.  FORWARD.
An unstoppable hunger like a black hole devours you from within.
Your prey stares you down, unaware that your mate has already flanked it.
You stir, saddened that your beautiful hatchlings were only a dream.
You dream of a world one hundred million years gone.
Your dreams are simple.  Movement among the leaves, your heart pounding as you leap through the air, satisfaction when your claws find purchase.
You curl up some more in your nest.  Geez, shredded paper really *is* comfy.
Oh boy!  This hidey hole sure is swell.
Once we finish the burrow we'll settle down and start a little family.  Maybe just a dozen boys and a dozen girls.  Nice and cosy.
In your dreams, you blindly run through the pipes of the city, navigating the familiar byways via smell alone.
Sneaky sneak under the floorboards.  We will sneak all their crumbs for us.  But later, back to sleep for now.
You hear the sirens again, but this time you stay in your hole in the wall.  Nobody will think to look there!
You dream of crushing zombies with your pincer.
You have a vivid dream of shedding your carapace.  It feels good.
You sit at the bottom of the sea, staring without thought at all the world passing by overhead.

data.//: The Mycus is ONLY post-thresh, so many more here.
messages: We have been waiting a long time for a place such as this.
We will raise bountiful orchards and beautiful gardens.
The walking plants seek to harness us as a food source.  We will not allow that.
Our colonists are limitless.  We shall adapt to this world, as we adapt to all.
Non-Mycus sometimes reject the Marloss.  Our colonial efforts flourish with broad-minded guidance.
The seething masses attempt to wall non-Mycus away from the Marloss.  We will adapt and defeat them.

data.//: 4 hours 20 minutes per wall (from regular ground to full palisade) * 373 walls = ~1,567 hours.  Divided into 8-hour work shifts, thats ~196 days, or six and a half months for one person.  Presuming we have ~11 people working in a single shift, each building 1 wall, that should be ~18 days to build.  Please correct me if I messed up the math.

1 hour 30 minutes per wood wall * 50 walls = 75 hours for walls. 132 wood floors * 1 hour 40 minutes a floor = 220 hours. 1 hour 30 minutes per shelf * 68 shelves = 102 hours. (397 so far)  2 hours per roof * 132 roof tiles (assume same as floors) = 264 hours.
data.//2: In total, this takes 661 labor hours to build. Assuming work is in 8-hour shifts, that's 83 days, or 2 months and 22 days for a single worker.  Assume we have ~6 people on the job (isn't as urgent as a wall), this takes us ~14 days to build, or two weeks.

descriptions: Something ancient lurks behind your eyes, a patient and deadly hunter.
Your heart hammers at the thrill of a foreign thought, the thrill of taking wing,
A will that is and isn't you wants to sink down into the mud.
You just need to find your herd, then it will all be OK.
You have the inexplicable urge to run for miles and miles…
Your mind expands, like it's bursting out of your skull, but is it really you?.
There's a shadow hanging over you, and it craves blood.
You dream of a pair of ragged claws, scuttling across the floors of silent seas…
Stay calm, stay alert, and wait for your time to strike.

Everything is out to get you.  You have to be faster.
It's calling you back to the water.  You won't be able to resist forever.
The world speeds up around you.  Can you endure?
Your legs are heavy, your sweat like slime…
A fear that isn't yours lives in your gut.  Keep moving!
No matter what it takes, what you become, you must survive.
Your skin itches.  Something grips you by the brain stem.  It's time.
The dull scavengers of earth wax crafty to vex it and swell monstrous to plague it.  Things have learnt to walk that ought to crawl.
Something is devouring you, and in turn you must devour.

Firing blackpowder loads from a gun fouls it, which reduces reliability and, if left uncleaned, leads to rust.  It fouls the gun much faster than the use of modern smokeless powder cartridges.  Fouling is only a significant impact on reliability at high levels, but black powder fouling accumulates quickly.

Either this gun is brand new and came without lubrication or it was recently cleaned with a solvent without oiling afterwards.  Either way, it's not lubricated and will not cycle properly, and can even be damaged.

Fouling is caused by firing gunpowder loads repeatedly, which reduces reliability and can eventually cause damage to the gun.  Fouling accumulates slowly (unless blackpowder is used) due to the design of modern smokeless powder found in the vast majority of retail cartridges and it is not a significant problem until high levels of fouling are reached due to firing thousands of rounds without cleaning your firearm.

data.name: industrial green carpet
data.description: Firm, low-pile, high-durability carpet in a green color, for laying down on bare concrete, with a still-functioning light attached to the ceiling above.

data.name: laser chamber
data.description: A large section of metal tubing, balanced on spring supports to prevent any vibration from affecting the laser inside.

data.name: spatial compressor
data.description: A dizzyingly complex series of devices and readouts is on the outside of this machine's casing.  You imagine the inside would be incomprehensible.

data.name: fractal compressor
data.description: This space is infinite, and has no beginning or end.  But you can see both right here, in this churning mass of angles.

data.name: unfolded laser chamber
data.description: You can see the inside surface of this tube, and what it contains.  Thick, slimy red light oozes within it.

bash.sound: a hollow pop, followed by a sickly wet squelching as congealed light slowly leaks out of the tube.

data.name: leaking laser chamber
data.description: Gobbets of congealed light drip from the gash in the side of this chamber like hot marmalade.

data.name: concrete floor
data.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

data.name: reinforced concrete wall
data.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

data.name: precision laser emitter
data.description: A huge casing for a device that generates and focuses a laser of an incredibly precise wavelength.

data.name: wall of flat space
data.description: From a distance, this looks like where the chamber ends; a flat wall, with a very detailed painting of a tunnel behind it.  But as you get closer, you can see how it ripples, like lazy water, and notice angles of the space beyond that a flat image could never give.

data.name: unfolded machinery
data.description: This inscrutable device is filled with wires, boards, and connections.  You can see every one of them, and it gives you a headache.

data.name: photonic conduit
data.description: You can see through the metal casing of this tube, into the blazing light coursing through it.

data.name: whiteboard
data.description: A wide space of whiteboard, for writing on with washable markers.  No one has washed it in a long time, though; it is covered in dense scrawls of equations and waveform diagrams.
A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It's plugged in and ready to go.
This device effectively sterilizes water.  Activate it to clean all water in a connected tank, at the cost of some electricity.
A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Ready to be played.
An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.  Plugged in and ready to go.
An electric forge, plugged in and ready to be used for metalworking.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a forge, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.

An electric kiln for baking brick or clay.  When plugged in and powered you could use this to harden bricks or clay.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a kiln, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects, from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table.  Used for making straight, measured cuts, it's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  Plugged in and ready to go.
This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves.  Plugged in and ready to go.

A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it nice and smooth.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A makeshift extraction system, or as makeshift as you can consider something that was purpose-built in a laboratory by a group of experts.
If you really want to squash something a lot, this is exactly the right industrial tool for you.  Plugged in and ready to go.
This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A makeshift appliance which decomposes water into oxygen and hydrogen via electrolysis of sodium hydroxide solution, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  It has a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via the Haber-Bosch process, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

A small gas-powered generator.  If filled up and turned on, it will provide enough power for camping or running basic appliances.

data.name: glowing tendril
data.description: A willowy tendril growing from the floor, gently waving back and forth.  A faint light spills from it.

data.name: wafting anemone
data.description: A fleshy white protuberance growing from the floor, with a cluster of tendrils protruding from it.  It looks almost exactly like a sea anemone, even waving gently as though underwater.

data.name: gasping tube
data.description: A meaty green stalactite with a thickened hide like that of a starfish, extending from the floor to the ceiling.  In the center is a series of ports somewhat like mouths, from which pour bursts of a vile-smelling gas.
data.//: TODO: Make a custom toxic gas emission that is not visible to the player

data.name: twitching frond
data.description: A spine resembling moth antennae juts from the ground, swaying gently in the air.  Every so often, a cascade of energy arcs along it and discharges into the ceiling.
data.//: TODO: Make a custom toxic gas emission that is not visible to the player

data.name: scarred lump
data.description: A pile of nondescript alien flesh, twitching and belching strange gases out of injured orifices.
data.//: TODO: Make a custom toxic gas emission that is not visible to the player

data.name: slimy pod
data.description: A slick, translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  It is covered in a thick mucus, obscuring whatever is floating in the gel-like substance inside.

data.name: organ pod
data.description: A translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside you can see the dimly outlined shape of human organs, floating in some kind of preservative goo.

data.name: resin pod
data.description: A translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside is a clean, clear, resinous-looking fluid.  You could fairly easily tear it from the stalk and take it with you.

data.name: fleshy altar
data.description: This pulsing protuberance juts from the floor, its sides covered in scaled, oozing skin.  The surface is flat, but undulates softly.  A handful of unidentifiable appendages reach from the sides, suggesting a sort of nightmarish robotic surgical bed.

data.name: crystalline flower
data.description: A crystalline structure that resembles a plant.
data.//: decorative flora for breather biome.

data.name: less than nothing
data.description: There is nothing here.  Not even time or space.

data.name: impaled officer
data.description: A dead body encased in high-tech armor hanging in the air.  Their form seems twisted and refracted in the light of the strange glowing crystal that has seeped out of the ground and impaled their body.
A dead body encased in military armor hanging in the air.  Their form seems twisted and refracted in the light of the strange glowing crystal that has seeped out of the ground and impaled their body.
data.name: impaled mercenary
empty spike
data.description: A strange otherworldly spike that refracts light in strange ways.  The body no longer rests on it.

effect.u_message: The body is gone but it can't have gone far, you need to destroy it.

data.name: cooling unit
data.description: A large, blocky appliance encased in sheet metal.  This commonplace fixture is used for cooling large indoor areas.

data.name: central air filter
data.description: A large synthetic membrane used to filter out dust, smoke, mites, and other contaminants from air that passes through it.

data.name: dishwasher
data.description: A large, boxy machine that uses hot water and soap to efficiently clean batches of dishes.  Now that it's sat powerless for a while, a putrid scent of rot is leaking from inside.

data.name: dryer
data.description: A common household appliance used to quickly dry large batches of clothing after they have been washed.

data.name: furnace
data.description: A gas-powered forced-air central heating unit, with an internal fan to push the air through a building's ventilation system to keep it warm.

data.name: washing machine
data.description: An appliance used to clean laundry.  It needs to be plugged into a grid that provides it with electricity and large amounts of water to be used.

data.name: electric oven
data.description: A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It can safely contain a fire, although it's not adequately ventilated.  You could disconnect it and plug it into a working power grid.
data.//: TODO: Replace FIRE_CONTAINER with some flag choking out small fires

data.name: gas oven
data.description: A standard gas-powered oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  With the state of nearby gas lines unknown, it's best not to put any fire near it.

data.name: gas oven and microwave combo
data.description: A standard gas-powered oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  This one has an attached microwave.  With the state of nearby gas lines unknown, it's best not to put any fire near it.  You could disassemble the shelving holding them together and pull the microwave out.

data.name: blacksmith bellows
data.description: An old device for pushing air into a blacksmith's forge to strengthen the fire and maintain a high temperature.  Useless in its current state, but good for parts.

data.name: blacksmith drop hammer
data.description: An anvil with a large metal hammer suspended above it in a metal framework.  It would be useful for shaping softened metal plates, or you could use the anvil by itself.

data.name: document shredder
data.description: A simple electronic device mounted to a large basket.  It is designed to efficiently destroy paper documents with sensitive information.  Good for parts, as identity theft and corporate espionage probably aren't big concerns anymore.

data.name: server stack
data.description: A large rack of specialized computers for storing and transmitting information.  Powerless and largely useless for its intended purpose, the laptops mounted inside can still be used if removed.

data.name: supercomputer
data.description: Hanging platters assembled into an inverted cone, their positions kept stable by dense threading of copper cabling.

data.name: large satellite dish
data.description: A large, concave metal panel with simple electronics used to receive signals from satellites.  While the hundreds of expensive machines orbiting the planet will likely continue to function indefinitely, their various purposes have all been lost.

data.name: mounted polycrystalline solar panel
data.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses less efficient polycrystalline solar panels.

data.name: mounted monocrystalline solar panel
data.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses more efficient monocrystalline solar panels.

data.name: oxygen concentrator
data.description: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  It needs power to function.

data.name: high pressure compressor unit
data.description: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  It needs large amounts of power to function.

data.name: road barricade
data.description: A large wooden blockade used to block passage through a road.  It is lined with reflective tape to increase visibility.  Despite the name, it does little to stop a moving car.

data.name: gravelbag barricade
data.description: A low wall made of stacked gravelbags, uncommonly used to catch bullets and block flooding.

data.name: gravelbag wall
data.description: A wall of stacked gravelbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

data.name: earthbag barricade
data.description: A low wall made of stacked earthbags, commonly used to catch bullets and block flooding.

data.name: earthbag wall
data.description: A wall of stacked earthbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

data.name: lane guard
data.description: A simple wooden post to mark the separation between street lanes.

data.name: sandbag barricade
data.description: A low wall made of canvas sacks filled with sand, commonly used to catch bullets and prevent flooding.

data.name: sandbag wall
data.description: A wall of stacked sandbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

data.name: show jump
data.description: A show jump made of a long pole, suitable for showing off your equestrian skills.

data.name: show jump
data.description: The end of a show jump made of planks.

data.name: scattered seaweed
data.description: Seaweed and other detritus, scattered along the high water line of the beach.

data.name: driftwood
data.description: A chunk of old wood, bleached white by sun and salt.

data.name: standing mirror
data.description: A full-length mirror mounted in a sleek aluminum frame.

data.name: broken standing mirror
data.description: An aluminum frame for a full-length mirror, with most of the mirror missing.  What remains in the frame are large, dangerous-looking shards of fractured glass.

data.name: bitts
data.description: A pair of vertical iron posts mounted on a wharf, pier, or other form of dock.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

data.name: cleat
data.description: A small horn cleat with two "horns" extending parallel to the deck or the axis of the spar, and resembling a small anvil.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

data.name: manacles
data.description: A pair of metal shackles with heavy chains mounted to a wall or floor.

data.name: statue
data.description: A massive block of stone that has been carefully carved into a work of timeless art.

data.name: mannequin
data.description: A life-size wooden figure of a person, most commonly used to display clothing in stores, or for tailors to design outfits on.  Considering all that's happened, something about it is somewhat unnerving.

data.name: birdbath
data.description: A wide stone bowl mounted to a pedestal, usually filled with rainwater, meant for birds to play or bathe in.

data.name: gazing ball
data.description: A mirrored glass globe mounted on a cement pedestal.  It warps your reflection when you look into it.

data.name: rotary clothes dryer line
data.description: A central metal pole holding up a wide rotating frame, this would be used to hang up clothes to dry in the sunlight.

data.name: standing lamp
data.description: A light mounted on the top of a metal pole, this would be plugged into a wall socket to illuminate a room.

data.name: lighthouse light
data.description: Very high power, modern lighthouse LED light source with attached heatsinks.

data.name: pine wreath
data.description: A decorative wreath for the winter holidays.

data.name: sand castle
data.description: A glorious castle made of sand.  This mighty fortress will stand tall for the ages to come, a true testament to the skills of its builder.

data.name: decorative tree
data.description: A decorative pine tree littered with ornaments for the winter holidays.

data.name: styling station
data.description: A styling station, is a countertop with a mirror mounted above it and just enough room and cubbies to store a stylist's equipment on it.

data.name: indoor flagpole
data.description: A 2.5-meter tall flagpole on a weighted stand.  You could hoist up a flag here.

data.name: indoor plant
data.description: A small potted plant, used for decoration indoors.  It appears to have dried up and died a while ago.

data.name: yellow indoor plant
data.description: A decorative potted plant with a yellow flower, it looks to have wilted and died some time ago.

data.name: overgrown plant
data.description: This patch of green used to be a cultivated field or some sort of monocrop agriculture.  Neglected for too long, it has been overtaken by nature.

data.name: harvestable plant
data.description: This plant is fully grown and ready to be harvested.  Identifying how to harvest it requires closer examination.

data.name: mature plant
data.description: This plant has matured, and will be ready to harvest before long.

data.name: seed
data.description: A freshly planted seed.  If properly tended to, it could grow into a healthy plant.

data.name: seedling
data.description: A seed that has just begun to sprout its first roots.

data.name: mutant tree
data.description: This bizarre tree spreads its twisted branches at odd angles toward the sky.  If you squint, it almost looks like a human figure with its arms raised to catch the sun.

data.name: mutant sapling
data.description: A twisted and gnarled little tree.  Its shape is at once alien and familiar.

data.name: sprout
data.description: A tiny little sprout that has just begun to grow.

data.name: planter
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.

data.name: planter with dead plants
data.description: Somewhere beneath this heap of dying plants you can see the shape of wooden furniture.  Left without care, the plants it used to nurture have shriveled and died.

data.name: planter with harvestable plant
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a fully grown plant, and will need closer examination to harvest.

data.name: planter with mature plant
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a matured plant that should be ready for harvest before long.

data.name: planter with seed
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one contains a planted seed, and will need attention to grow fully.

data.name: planter with seedling
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a seed that has just begun to sprout its first roots.

data.name: grain stook
data.description: Sheaves of cut grain have been stood upright in a self-supporting A-frame to dry, keeping the seeds off the ground and out of reach of vermin.

data.name: stooking spot
data.description: A space has been cleared out here for grain drying.  Place fresh stalks of grain in this spot and examine to set up a stook.

data.name: spider egg sac
data.description: A sizable, off-white sac of large eggs.  Upon watching closer, you can see them moving slightly.  Gross.

data.name: spider egg sac
data.description: A bulbous mass of off-white spider eggs.  Upon watching closer, you can see them moving a bit.  Really gross.

data.name: spider egg sac
data.description: A gigantic sac of spider eggs, each one larger than your fist.  They're definitely moving around.  Really gross, just seeing it makes your skin crawl.

data.name: ruptured egg sac

data.name: fireplace
data.description: A common fixture for safely hosting a fire indoors, with a chimney to vent the smoke to the outside.

data.name: stone fireplace
data.description: A common fixture for safely hosting a fire indoors, with a chimney to vent the smoke to the outside.

data.name: wood stove
data.description: A simple metal stove for hosting wood-fueled fires.  Good for cooking or heating food, and safe to use indoors.

data.name: brazier
data.description: A raised metal dish in which to safely burn things.

data.name: makeshift brazier
data.description: A metal bucket with holes, in which you can safely start a fire.  It's too small to fit any fuel item larger than some splintered wood.

data.name: hobo stove
data.description: A small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can.  It's too small to fit any fuel much larger than splintered wood.

data.name: portable stove
data.description: A foldable metal stove for hosting wood-fueled fires.  Good for cooking or heating food, and safe to use indoors.

data.name: fire barrel (200 L)
data.description: A huge metal barrel used to safely contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in the sides for air supply.

data.name: fire barrel (100 L)
data.description: A large metal barrel used to safely contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in the sides for air supply.

data.name: fire ring
data.description: A ring of stones to safely contain a fire.

data.name: clay oven
data.description: A simple clay oven with a chimney, with a firebrick alcove in the middle that can be used to cook food or just to contain a fire.

data.name: poppy flower
data.description: Papaver somniferum, also known as the opium poppy.  These harmless-looking flowers were once widely cultivated for decorative purposes, but in summer their heads may be harvested and used in the production of a highly addictive painkiller.
data.//: todo: poppy straw for extraction,

data.name: dandelion
data.description: A common weed with a yellow flower.  Produces seeds that get carried on the wind by thin, gray filaments.

data.name: burdock
data.description: A common weed with a purple thistle-like flower.  Its seeds tend to stick to clothing and fur.

data.name: dead plant
data.description: This plant has joined the billions lost in the Cataclysm, and is now little more than a dry stalk.

data.name: wild carrot
data.description: A common white wildflower which could be harvested for its root.

data.name: starry false Solomon's seal
data.description: The blossoms of this flower look like stars in the night sky.  Its crimson berries are edible.

data.name: salsify
data.description: Tragopogon porrifolius, a ragged-looking purple flower with a nutritious root.
data.//: Root can always be harvested, but there is no flower to harvest seeds from in winter.

data.name: chamomile
data.description: A cute white flower with a yellow center, used to brew a soothing tea.

data.name: tulip
data.description: A bright, colorful flower with petals forming a small cup at its top.  It can be poisonous to livestock.

data.name: spurge flower
data.description: A yellow-green flower that grows in densely-packed bushes.

data.name: cattails
data.description: This useful plant is available all year round.  Many parts of the plant are edible.

data.name: black eyed Susan
data.description: A mildly poisonous yellow flower with a dark ball in the middle.  Sometimes known as an ox-eye daisy.
data.//: Add flower and bud spawns once useful.

data.name: lily
data.description: A pretty flower that comes in a variety of colors.
data.//: Add flower and bud spawns once useful.

data.name: lotus
data.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of fresh water.  A traditional symbol of many Eastern cultures.
data.//: Add flower and bud spawns once useful.

data.name: sunflower
data.description: A tall, wide-headed flower with a large dark center.  Produces many nutritious seeds.

data.name: Jerusalem artichoke plant
data.description: Looking similar to a sunflower, this tall plant has a nutritious tuber.

data.name: lilypad
data.description: This lilypad doesn't look like it would support the weight of the things you've heard croaking in the swamp.

data.name: bluebell
data.description: A common bluebell flower.  Pretty.

data.name: dahlia
data.description: A puffy flower with many tightly-layered petals.

data.name: chicory
data.description: A blue flower imported from Europe, also known as a cornflower.

data.name: datura
data.description: A pretty moonflower.

data.name: pile of leaves
data.description: A sizable pile of leaves.  You could sleep on it if you don't care about comfort or warmth.

data.name: mustard
data.description: A yellow flower known as Brassica Nigra.  Known for its seeds that can be used for making table mustard.

data.name: wild sarsaparilla
data.description: A small, flowering plant known as 'Aralia nudicaulis'.  It is colored in vibrant shades of orange and red in autumn, making it easy to spot.

data.name: wintergreen
data.description: A small shrub native to North America.  The leaves, which remain green even in winter, are valued for medicinal purposes.  It produces edible and sweet berries, too!
data.//: green all year long

data.name: Japanese knotweed
data.description: An invasive species originating from Japan.  The stem looks like it might contain some water.

data.name: fireweed
data.description: Vibrant purple, it tends to be the first to appear after fires, hence its name.

data.name: common selfheal
data.description: A small purple flower.  It got its name due to its usage in traditional medicine.

data.name: spreading dogbane
data.description: It is not only toxic to dogs when eaten by them.  Humans and many other animals are affected, too.  Its fibers sure are worth salvaging though.  Despite its name, it is not actually spreading fast.

data.name: thistle
data.description: A prickly and invasive small plant.

data.name: purple loosestrife
data.description: A pretty violet flower that likes water.  Unfortunately it is invasive and does not benefit the environment.

data.name: wild rice
data.description: Also called Indian rice, Northern wild rice, or manoomin in Ojibwe, is a species of rice that has been harvested and used by Native American tribes of the northeast for hundreds of years.  It's similar to other types of wild rice, offering a fiber-rich and healthy basis of a meal.

data.name: short hedge
data.description: A shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a squared shape.

data.name: tall hedge
data.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a squared shape.

data.name: abstract topiary
data.description: A shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a fanciful abstract shape.

data.name: animal topiary
data.description: A shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into an animal shape.

data.name: animal topiary
data.description: A shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a dragon shape.

data.name: dam
data.description: A house that beavers built.  The entrance is underwater making it harder for predators to access.

data.name: red algae
data.description: One of the thousands of species of grassy reddish marine plants that inhabit intertidal zones the world over.  Its rubbery little fronds don't look particularly edible.

data.name: green algae
data.description: A short patch of grassy green seaweed, wholly unremarkable.

data.name: sugar kelp
data.description: Also known as kombu, this brown algae grows in a single leaflike blade that can reach more than twice the height of a man.  Young fronds make for excellent soup stock and can even be eaten raw.

data.name: sea lettuce
data.description: Sometimes known as green laver, this leafy algae from the Ulva genus grows in leafy little patches around shallows and tide pools.  Though small, it makes a tasty snack.

data.name: bladderwrack
data.description: Named for the air bladders that grow all over its leafy fronds, this leafy seaweed is technically edible and has a long history of use in folk medicine.

data.name: sea anemone
data.description: This sessile polyp waves its stinging tentacles with the motion of the tides, hoping to capture a tiny fish or crab.  It's wholly inedible and poses no danger to anything bigger than a shrimp.

data.name: sea sponge
data.description: An immobile, lumpy little creature that looks nothing like a square kitchen sponge.  Anchored to the sea floor, its porous body passively filters plankton from the water that freely passes through it.

data.name: Marloss flower
data.description: This flower looks mostly like the other flowers taken by the mushrooms, but its bulb is a brilliant cyan color.  It emits an aroma that is both overwhelming and strangely alluring.

data.name: fungal flower
data.description: This flower has been overgrown by gray, sinewy tendrils of fungus, and the color has been leached from its petals and stem.  It gently sways of its own volition, maintaining an unsettling rhythm.

data.name: fungal mass
data.description: Thick ropes of Mycal matter have covered the ground here completely.  It's soft to the touch, but not firm enough to hold any weight.

data.name: fungal clump
data.description: Alien mold and stems mingle tightly here, swaying around and weaving together, creating a sort of fungal bush.

data.name: fungal tangle
data.description: Thick, ropy tendrils of fungus have risen from the ground and gathered into an impenetrable clump.

data.name: stone slab
data.description: A slab of heavy stone, with a reasonably flat surface.

data.name: headstone
data.description: A large slab of stone, engraved with information on the deceased individual buried beneath.  While only a solemn reminder of the uncountable losses of the Cataclysm, a proper final resting place grants an odd sense of peace.

data.name: gravestone
data.description: An upright slab of stone with information engraved on the face about whoever lies beneath.  While only a solemn reminder of the countless casualties of the Cataclysm, a proper final resting place grants an odd sense of peace.

data.name: worn gravestone
data.description: An aged and eroded gravestone, damaged to the point of rendering the inscription illegible.  Whoever's buried here was probably lucky enough to pass before all this chaos began.

data.name: obelisk
data.description: A magnificent carved statue with an engraved plaque fixed to the base.  It serves to honor the passing of somebody significant, something one wishes was still a practical goal.

data.name: battlefield cross
data.description: A makeshift memorial marker, made of a service rifle - buried in the dirt, or nestled in a pair of boots - with a helmet perched on the stock.  A small way to honor the dead.
A large vat with a motorized mixing device for combining large quantities of chemicals.
