data.description: Its paws have grown to be longer, and it seems capable of briefly standing on its hindlimbs.  You wonder if this sleazy beast is able to open doors yet.

From a distance, this freak of nature could almost be taken for a draft horse but for its tufted ears and the set of its eyes, mounted at the front of its face beneath the cunning brow of a predator.  Its hooves are splayed out to form three-toed claws that grip rock and soil alike as it prowls the fields, and from time to time an overlong forked tongue slips out of its fanged maw to taste the air.

petfood.feed: The %s devours the meat.  It growls low at you, but no longer seems quite as unfriendly.

data.description: A spindly abomination taller than a house and whipping its disgusting body around in apparent agony.  It's awful to look at, but worst of all is the realization that this is a human being, twisted and stretched like a piece of chewing gum, and somehow still alive.

This thing has the general shape of a human, but that's where the resemblance stops.  Featureless and pale, its face is entirely missing, leaving only a huge hole that leads down what might be a throat.  Adding to its unearthly appearance is the way it moves, stiff and doll-like as though it was only feigning knowing how to walk.
A defiled human body, once living.  Tortured to death long ago, it remains chained to the altar, the putrescent flays of its peeled skin quivering like so much flotsam upon a murky pond.
Uncountable jagged spikes, cleaving reality as they fly through its invisible seams.
Misshapen spikes of concrete and rebar crumble upwards from the floor, held aloft by strands of visual distortion.  Sound around it is drowned and distorted into an incessant drone.

death_function.message: The distortion fades as the %s crumbles.

special_attacks.monster_message: Scraps of metal fly off the spur and into the nearby swarms!

data.description: A gigantic shadow, chaotically changing in shape and volume.  Two piercing orbs of light dominate what can only be described as its head.
A crazed individual, the bloody scars on the side of its shaved head suggest some sort of partial lobotomy.
A domesticated mongrel of the canine persuasion.  In the absence of human society, it has turned feral.

petfood.feed: If you're seeing this message it's a bug.
petfood.pet: If you're seeing this message it's a bug.

data.description: An enormous disembodied eyeball the size of a person, flying through the air through some unknown agency.  Wreathed in unnatural flickering blue flame, it possesses a blazing yellow iris with a slitted pupil like that of a cat, and trails a set of flailing black tendrils as it slowly drifts about.  You involuntarily get a heavy, sinking feeling deep in your gut as you watch its gaze comb over the world around it.
A half-polypous, utterly alien creature.  It is a large writhing tumor of eyes, mouths and tentacles; It's only partly material and has the ability to fly, despite the absence of wings.

Originally invisible, you can now see the myriad writhing tentacles tipped with gnashing maws that make up this creature.  The small central body is dominated by an enormous fanged mouth from which emerges a near-constant high-pitched tittering.

data.description: There was nothing here a moment ago, but now you see the faintest outline of an otherworldly creature approaching you with jittery leaps.  Trying to focus on it reveals a pointed beak dripping translucent fluid and rows upon rows of bladed legs grasping the floor, before your eyes begin to burn and your head starts to spin.
data.//grab: Great at pulling, bad at holding - maybe it's playing with you

data.description: This is some sort of unnatural cross between a bull and a man.  Quite different from the minotaur of legend, it possesses a shaggy white bull's head on an otherwise unremarkable human body.  It grunts and snuffles, drooling ropey strands of white slobber down its chest.  You occasionally catch a glint in its eyes and freeze up involuntarily, like a deer in headlights.
A dog's body with a mass of ropey, black tentacles reaching out from its head.

A grotesque dog-like beast, its frame is angular and emaciated and its head is like that of an abyssal fish.  When it moves, its twisted limbs duplicate, merge, disappear, and reform in dissonance, as if a hundred copies of itself were somehow forced to inhabit the same space.  Extraneous to our reality, it moves between the corners of the world, hunting those that would dare step beyond time and space.

A grotesque dog-like beast, its frame is angular and emaciated and its head is like that of an abyssal fish.  When it moves, its twisted limbs duplicate, merge, disappear, and reform in dissonance, as if a hundred copies of itself were somehow forced to inhabit the same space.  Extraneous to our reality, it moves between the corners of the world, hunting those that would dare step beyond time and space.
An enormous fleshy snail, with an oddly human face.  Eyestalks protrude from where the eyes should be.

This is some sort of great viperine creature, possessed of a curiously distorted head and massive clawed appendages.  It partially supports itself with the aid of black, rubbery wings of monstrous dimensions.  The wings beat slowly like an eagle while the body coils through the air like how an eel swims in water.

An animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany the quiet murmur, trying to forcefully supplant your own.
An animate shadow in the form of a long and sinuous snake.  Translucent and dark, it glides silently across the floor, wriggling and flexing as it moves.
An amorphous black creature, detaching and sprouting tentacles without any apparent pause.
A human body, but with its limbs, neck, and hair impossibly twisted.  It clambers around swiftly, making awful screeching sounds.

A huge, slimy worm-like creature.  Its pale, flattened head drips an oily mucus as it breaches the ground, searching for prey.  Its pinkish mouth opens and closes, revealing long fangs glistening with ropey strands of saliva, which leave smoldering stains wherever they drip.

special_attacks.description: The yugg launches a viscous barb!

data.description: A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

An animate blotch of conflicting symmetries, erratically hovering through the air.  It's not even real enough to hold a stable shape, and its entire form is constantly in flux.  You can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

special_attacks.monster_message: The shifting mass passes through you as if you were an illusion, and a slight wave of fatigue washes over you.

data.description: A twisted shape floating in midair; its angles don't seem to quite add up - it hurts to look at.  Is it inanimate?  Alive?  Something else?  You can't make heads or tails of it at all, but you can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

special_attacks.monster_message: You get a very clear view of the impossible shape.

data.description: The silhouette of a human body, reaching towards you like it needs help.  It has no eyes, but you can still feel it staring through you.

death_function.message: The %s begins to cry as it disappears.

data.description: A figure in a high-tech suit, their outline contorted as though you were viewing them through a prism.  Their movements are strained but determined, pushing through apparent pain with feverish resolve, dead-set on reaching their target.

special_attacks.monster_message: The creature screams "SOMEONE HELP ME, ANYONE!".

data.description: A figure in combat gear, distorted and shattered like broken glass.  They thrash around as they move, an expression of shock and anguish frozen on their face.

death_function.message: The soldier fades away to nothing.

data.description: Your shadow is host to something alien.

death_function.message: Your shadow seemingly becomes normal again.

data.description: A common human.  It looks exactly like a human looks.  You can see them.  They can see you.  You know they know you can see them.  They know you know you can see them.  They move towards you.
data.//: it must be spooky, but god im bad in this stuff

special_attacks.monster_message: You feel something was destroyed inside you.

data.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, memories of your wrongdoings rise to the surface.

special_attacks.monster_message: The guilt makes no physical movement and yet you feel the force of its assault.  Everything feels heavier.

data.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, a desire to stop moving rises.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sloth does nothing, and you feel time itself aiding your desire to do nothing.

data.description: What looks to be a loose mass of worm-like appendages reveals a solid body beneath, a great maw of rows of serrated fangs taking up most of the body.  It is either very lethargic or stalking prey, sitting in place without much obvious motion.
A wriggling brown grub of unnatural origin, slithering along the ground and unnaturally pulsating.  As it moves along, it chews through any available flesh with surprising speed.
A strange quadrupedal creature with long, lanky limbs and a gaping maw.  A long sharp spike protrudes from it's back, which occasionally launches from its' joint to stab prey before slinking back in.
A very wet, snake-like creature which you estimate to be five feet long, covered in slime and slithering about.  Occasionally, it will attach itself to the flesh around it and begin to suck.
A small fish symbiote that resembles a deformed, eyeless piranha.  It swims blindly in the yellow ichor, wriggling incessantly with malicious intent.

Four whiplike legs support a monster that at a distance resembles a skinless rider and horse fused into one grotesque apparition.  Arms tipped in scythelike claws hang almost to the ground, and a noxious fog constantly spews from the terrible mouth that runs the length of its body.

There is barely anything there, but you do notice hints of a faint, translucent veiled creature that you can only describe as butterfly-like.  While strangely alluring, it seems unsuited to the atmosphere and is slowly falling apart.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s's wings move in odd ways and a strange glow envelops you!

data.description: A small chunk of curious looking roots, constantly trying to grow and expand but failing miserably.  It has grown weak, as if incompatible with the very soil it is in.
This small, three legged bug-like creature curiously wriggles its 5 antennae.  Its body somewhat reminds you of a stink bug.  It looks like a fish out of water and is getting weaker by the minute.
A writhing mass of strange flesh and something that oddly resembles tentacles.  It is getting more pale by the minute.

A tall, thin stalk of rubbery flesh, creeping around on a sluglike foot at its base.  The blob you might call the "head" is riddled with brightly glowing, yellow-green pustules, while a line down the middle seems to function as its mouth.  It looks unhealthy, like it's withering away.

special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %s reaches for you, but you dodge!

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: The %s opens its "mouth" and snaps at you!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: The %s opens its "mouth" and snaps at <npcname>!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: The %s opens its "mouth" and snaps at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: The %s opens its "mouth" and snaps at <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: The %s opens its "mouth" and snaps at you, but fails to penetrate armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: The %s opens its "mouth" and snaps at <npcname>, but fails to penetrate armor.

data.description: As it moves, this cat's colors shift unnaturally in the light.  You can't make out the breed, but its fur pattern seems to change with every step.
data.//: Higher dodge due to the constantly changing fur pattern

data.description: It is universally known that cats are liquid, but this cat's body is actually quivering while it walks around.  It also enjoys resting while twisting its body in ways that would break a normal cat's bones.

death_function.message: The %s's body splashes one last time.

data.description: Seeing how unnaturally dark this black cat's fur is, you are certain this is no ordinary cat.  Its fur seems to absorb light from the surroundings.

This dog doesn't cast a shadow, and if you squint hard enough you can see right through it.  Its condition doesn't appear to do any harm to it, though it seems to cause trouble when it tries to groom itself.
A rather average looking dog until you notice the third eye, right on its forehead, covered by a thick eyelid.  Whenever its open, small particles of dust from the ground rise and swirl around it.

You are completely unable to recall anything about what this dog looks like.  You know it's a dog, you know it's there, you know you can see it, but any further information about it isn't retained in your mind.
A timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.
The timber rattlesnake, the most venomous viper native to New England.  These animals prefer to avoid humans, but can be very dangerous if they bite.
data.//babies: On average, a female rattlesnake gives birth to at least eight babies, up to around fifteen.  Most baby rattlesnakes are born in the early summer, but sometimes in late summer and early autumn.

data.description: A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.
A large mutated timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.
A timber rattlesnake grown to the size of an anaconda.  Ordinarily these animals are timid and prefer to avoid humans, but at this size it might be convinced to put up a fight.

A primal fear strikes when the club-like tail of this massively warped snake shifts, an assortment of bones rattling softly.  Multiple sets of hollow fangs have erupted in its maw, which itself is flanked by skinless ropes of powerful muscle.  Its scales constantly shed off and regrow with unnatural speed.
data.//grab: Big jaw full of long fangs - about as grabby as you can get without multiple appendages, consider a coiling attack on next update
data.//grab2: You brought this upon yourself, serpentdom is proud
data.//babies: Rattlesnake's gestation period is around 90 days, but it varies depending on the breed.  The timber rattlesnake has a gestation period of up to five months.
data.//babies2: Deathrattle is heavily mutated, so a short gestation period and all-year large clutch birth are plausible

data.description: An aggressive mutant variety of the worm snake, turned pale yellow from lack of sunlight.  It swarms beneath the ground, and is named for its habit of infesting sewer lines.
A teeny tiny baby frog, smaller than a penny.  It's basically just a head with a tail.
A tadpole the size of a bass.  At this size, it's easy to spot the little growths that will eventually become its limbs.
The American bullfrog, a slimy green amphibian the size of a rat.  It feeds on insects, mice, lizards and any other living thing it can stuff down its gullet.
A hopping amphibian that has grown big enough to eat a small dog.  It looks unwell, as if this growth spurt was less than comfortable.
A mutated frog taller than a man.  Its huge mouth and dumpy body aren't quite as funny at this size.

data.description: This appears to be a very experimental automated tower.  Lacking armor plating and seemingly half-built, it's little more than an oversized laser emitter and a camera, both welded to a swiveling platform.

A white and brown quadcopter drone mounting what looks to be a camera dome and a large antenna array.  It calmly hovers a comfortable distance above the ground, surveiling its surroundings with cold indifference.
An an armed and up-armored skitterbot, clad in white plastic plating and mounting a stripped down 7.62 battle rifle over its original cam-arm.

special_attacks.description: The exterminatron legs lock into place as it swings its turret to bear.

data.description: This cat-sized rat snuffles along the ground looking for things to eat.  It hisses at anything that comes near it, baring sizable teeth.

Prior to the Cataclysm someone might have referred to this dog-sized rat as a 'mass of claws and teeth,' but that could describe nearly everything you meet these days.  In any case, this particular mass of claws and teeth is eyeing its surroundings hungrily.

This mutated rodent stands on two legs, as tall as a man.  It has a habit of shoving shiny objects into its cheek pouches, and eyes its surroundings with too-human eyes that sparkle with greed, but not intellect.
A black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.
A large black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.
A small black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.
A formless glob of slime the size of a cow.  Crusty bits of cytoplasm fall away as it oozes across the ground.

A gargantuan protoplasmic blob, constantly reshaping, forming new pseudopods seemingly at will.  All over its body are eyes that form and disappear.  The rapid and chaotic way it reconstitutes itself gives the impression of it boiling over with some kind of primordial fury.
A small wriggling slime, a first line of defense for the whole.
A spire of hardened slime, coated in rotating eyespots and glistening ocular nerves.
This moving, black glob emits a foul stench that indicates that it has incorporated a great deal of sewage into itself.

death_function.message: The %s bursts, releasing its vile contents!

data.description: A horribly burned human, reeking of overcooked meat.  Their flesh has mended into a leathery shell, and the pupils of their wide-open eyes are dilated and the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  Somehow they still breathe, in deep, ragged gulps.

A horribly burned human, reeking of charred meat.  Their flesh has mended into a leathery shell, and the pupils of their wide-open eyes are dilated and the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  Somehow they still breathe, in deep, ragged gulps.

A horribly burned human, reeking of charred meat.  Their flesh has mended into a leathery shell, and the pupils of their wide-open eyes are dilated and the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  Somehow they still breathe, in deep, ragged gulps.
A short, fat stalk with broad leaves and tiny flower buds.
A thick stalk that rises five feet from the ground, with heavy, broad leaves at its base.  Purple flower buds adorn the top.
A drooped, quivering plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are closed, and pulsate ominously.

death_drops.//: 80% chance of an item from group biollante

data.description: A thick stalk, rooted to the ground.  It rapidly sprouts thorny vines in all directions.
A thorny vine, twisting wildly as it grows with incredible speed.
A teeny-tiny triffid that has recently germinated.  Like a house cat, you know it wants to eat you but it just can't figure out how.
A small triffid, only a few feet tall.  It has not yet developed bark, but its sting is still sharp and deadly.
A creeping mobile plant, as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.  Nature is healing.
A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid.  It has enormous red petals surrounded by a haze of spores, and two thick barbed vines stick out from the stems like wary harpoons.
An animated mass of roots and vines, creeping along the ground with alarming speed.  The tangle is thick enough that the center from which they grow is concealed.
A stout, woody plant that can dig through the ground and flick spines from its branches.  The thorns carry a fungicidal compound with paralytic effects.

death_drops.//: 80% chance of an item from group fungal_sting

data.description: A giant plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are open with an ominous shine in the center.
A knot of tubular roots, flowing with sap and beating like a heart.  Strands of vascular tissue reach out to the surrounding root walls.

A 9mm MP5 attached to a motorized chassis with basic autonomous software control.  There is no mechanism to reload the weapon when its magazine is empty, and the fire control system is only designed for semi-automatic fire.
A pylon boasting three high-powered searchlights with automated search AI, continually seeking targets.

death_function.message: As the final light is destroyed, it erupts in a blinding flare!

data.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a .50 caliber M2HB machine gun.
A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 5.56 caliber M249 machine gun.
A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 7.62 caliber M240 machine gun.

These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the Cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner-city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' does not mean 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the Cataclysm, massive stockrooms of these things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not mobile anymore.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Universal curfew is in effect.  Please return to your home.  This unit is authorized to open fire."

data.description: A high-powered loudspeaker set to loudly repeat messages on a loop.

A popular product from Uncanny, this friendly android can carry your bag or push your grocery cart for you.  You know it's friendly because its human-esque face is constantly smiling at you.  According to the ads, it uses a state-machine of a complexity never seen before.  Uncanny even hired professional actors to record its lines.  Examine to befriend.
A busted grocery bot, it can still carry your bag but its arms are too damaged to push a grocery cart.  Despite its current state, it's still smiling at you.  Examine to befriend.
The Ford Sanitron, a utility robot designed for cleaning up waste material in hazardous conditions.
A snake-like, segmented robot built to tunnel into the ground and detonate landmines.

data.//: nurse_bot and nurse_bot_defective look very similar, part of the trick is figuring out which one is the good one.  So the sprites should probably look pretty similar to not give it away immediately
data.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patients to assist.

data.//: nurse_bot and nurse_bot_defective look very similar, part of the trick is figuring out which one is the good one.  So the sprites should probably look pretty similar to not give it away immediately
data.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patients to assist.

Three dual leg modules join with each lower vertex of a pyramidal body, in a abstract configuration that vaguely recalls an alien arthropod.  Devoid of any exterior signs that betray its artificial origin, it looks like it could fold itself into a perfectly featureless quartz pyramid.  It crawls with a gait like none you've seen before, its minute movements too fast for your eyes to track.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: a fast sequence of clicking tones.

data.description: Its uncountable surfaces flow against each other in a dazzling sea of gold.
A kite shaped blade of metal, darting through air and foes by indiscernible means.

This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  This walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with putrid blood.
A zombie dog grown larger than most men.  Daggerlike teeth jut from its gaping maw at every angle, and its broad back ripples with unnatural arrangements of glistening muscle.
What may once have been a dog is now a grotesquely swollen monstrosity, standing on four limbs as wide as trash cans and showing massive, jagged teeth.
A four-legged creature covered in fused bony plates.  Its shape recalls a big dog or perhaps a wolf, though the original anatomy is largely hidden by its burdensome armor.

This undead boar appears to have been a truly massive specimen in life.  Stretching eight to nine feet in length, the most arresting feature of this animal is that the enamel of its tusks has spread across its face, leaving a skull-like appearance with deep-set eye holes.
Billowing clouds of yellowish gas precede a boar-shaped shadow.  Glimpses of a zombified boar are quickly obscured by the gases spewing forth from the open wounds on its body.

This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  Devoid entirely of flesh, this walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with each beat of its rotten heart.

As if a zombified bear wasn't already a problem, this one is layered in thick bone growths that protect it from harm.  The irregular way the plates grow against each other has somewhat stifled its movement, but not enough to stop it from easily gaining up on you.
Most of this bear's fur has burnt off and its body looks to be falling apart, not entirely immune to its own acidic fluids.  Despite its weakened state, the strength of a bear hasn't left it.

The carcass of this horse can no longer stand on all fours, but some unstoppable fury compels it to drag itself along anyway, chomping and stamping in mindless pursuit of anything that dares to breathe.

The abdomen of this once majestic horse has grown rotund to the point you can see through the skin, at the reservoir of caustic bile inside.  Its neck is equally enlarged as well as slightly longer than normal.

A zombified horse without skin, its overgrown, bloody musculature clear for all to see.  Some muscles occasionally tear from their tendons as it barrels towards its target, flailing around like a loose hose before weaving back into place.
This undead horse has a charred hide as black as soot, the underside of which is littered with gashes and holes.  Pillars of choking smoke pour from the wounds, smothering everything that draws near.

With plates of asymmetrical bone tissue overlapping its body, this ignoble steed needs no rider for you to fear its approach.  Completing its ghoulish look is an overgrown skull which, judging by the flattened and battered forehead, has become its main weapon.
This once-great moose's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.
data.//grab: Assuming it's grabbing with its mouth a bit grabbier than a zed should be about right

data.description: This once-great moose is covered with long, matted hair twisted with thorny vines that wrap together and then twist back into its body.  Long, interlocking thorns wrap its antlers, dripping with a silvery liquid.
data.//grab: Let's say the thorns make it half again as grabby

data.description: Once a normally-aggressive, normally-hungry bull shark, this undead terror is now even more aggressive and more hungry, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.
data.//: Sharks do not have bones.

data.description: Once a former apex predator of the seas, now an undead nightmare, this zombified Great White shark terrorizes the waters with its relentless hunger and aggression.
data.//: Sharks do not have bones.

data.description: The deformed, animated corpse of a canine; a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.
data.//grab: Pretty low, but they tend not to be alone

data.description: The reanimated corpse of a dog used in law enforcement.  Its deformed body is encased in a protective Kevlar harness.

death_drops.//: 40% chance of an item from group dog_cop

data.description: An acrid smell accompanies this limping canine corpse.  Its whole body is covered in chains of pulsing cysts and slime-dribbling ulcers.
A zombified wolf.  Putrescence oozes from its mouth to coat vicious-looking yellow fangs.
This black bear's eyes have gone filmy-white, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It moves with an unnaturally graceless gait.
The body of a stout, scruffy pig, reanimated now and somehow even angrier than it was in life.

This wall-eyed beast has a large wound on its side, its gore-stained ribs clearly visible.  Foamy corpse-bile dribbles from around its fearsome orange incisors, which look all the more intimidating now that the flesh of its face has begun to peel away.

This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection that is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast, suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is matted with necrotic discharge.

From the deteriorated state of this undead horse's ghastly features--protruding ribs, off-white skull, and decayed, tattered muscles--it doesn't seem like it should put up much of a fight, but something deep inside gives it power.  Reeking pus drips from its wounds.
This tiger stumbles and sways, its jaws slack, its eyes wide open and shining yellow-white.

This sheep's once pure white wool is now barely hanging by its rotten flesh, held together by dried mud and blood.  Its legs now buckle as the rotten muscles have a hard time sustaining the rest of the body.
The moving corpse of what once was a goat is now left stumbling around, its vacant eyes looking for anything alive to kill.
Dairy cows have no natural weapons, but a zombie as big, heavy, and murderous as this is still extremely dangerous.

death_drops.//: 25% chance of an item from group cow

data.description: This enormous, terrifyingly fast creature with blood-bloated eyes and dreadful horns was once a domestic bull.  While live bulls can be temperamental, unbridled rage is now this one's only emotion.

This llama oozes a dark oil from a multitude of lesions and cuts.  Its wool has sloughed off with parts of its skin, revealing pulsating muscles and flesh.  Its mouth drips with a sickly green substance which it seems to be chewing on.
The ragged remains of this woodland ungulate stagger madly about in search of anything that breathes.
What might have once been a noble creature has been reduced to a sorry sack of skin and bones, oozing gore as it trots along clumsily in search of something to kill.
Once a majestic caribou, this undead creature barely resembles Santa's helpful reindeer and seems to only be interested in human flesh.
A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.

death_drops.//: cloth as any other zombie (always), additional items from group hive (sometimes)

data.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.
A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged set of police gear.
This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its lower half is damaged beyond repair.
Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.
A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.  Its protective mask prevents it from attempting to bite you.
data.//grab: Slightly stronger, but can't bite because of the gear.

data.description: This zombie is completely encased in a protective suit that apparently failed to protect it from whatever this infection is.  At least it can't bite you from inside that suit.

weakpoints.name: a tear in its hazmat suit

data.description: A once-dead human corpse in a particularly advanced state of decay.  Its flesh sloughs away in patches and the swarm of insects crawling in and out of it are nearly as revolting as the smell.

This zombie was part of a specialized unit of law enforcement.  It still wears a battered armor with the SWAT logo emblazoned on the front.  The protective mask makes its head a difficult target, but also prevents it from biting you.
This was once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.
This zombie is rather sleek and scantily clothed.
This muscular zombie is dressed in the tattered remnants of a security uniform.
This shambling corpse is dressed like a medical professional.  It was either a doctor, or only played one on TV.
A malformed armor of misshapen bone has grown over this zombie, having pushed what remains of the skin out of the way.  The clothes of a medical worker are still draped over it.
This is the body of a doctor or nurse of some kind.  It's hard to tell now that most of its clothing has corroded away from whatever vile acid its secreting.
This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome, fleshy membrane.  The mutation does not suit it well: it moves clumsily, even compared to other zombies, but can occasionally leap a significant distance.
data.//: In the future, it would be nice if these guys could be resistant to fall damage.

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome, fleshy membrane.  The rest has become emaciated, with thin, rope-like muscles ripping through taut flesh.  While it doesn't appear to be able to fly, it uses its mutated arms to make shockingly fast leaps through the air.
data.//: Slow at actual movement, made up for by its rapid leaps.  This should work to simulate its clumsy form.  When charge attacks are possible it should get one, and that will be its main damaging ability.

data.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it is made of human parts.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged, pointed object.

This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, and a bloated, fleshy belly hangs beneath.  A sharp smell of rotten eggs hangs around it.

This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow juts out from the point where the wings meet.
A sickly-looking zombie.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

This zombie has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated, leathery body.  It moves clumsily, but spits from a large reserve of acid with uncanny accuracy.

death_function.message: The %s bursts apart in a shower of acid!

data.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.
A degenerate corpse, shambling as it walks.  Various pieces of trash and waste materials have melded into the black goo leaking from its skin.
data.//: Higher weight from attached junks.

data.description: A deformed, sickly-looking animated corpse of a canine.  A dangerous-looking yellow saliva drips from its mouth.

The reeking remains of what was once a dog.  Its torso is swollen up like a barrel, supported by unnaturally elongated legs.  Its fur has mostly been burned off by a corrosive liquid that leaks from is jaws and puckered sores all over its body.

data.description: A rigid, off-white lump of flesh the size of a small car constricted by bands of rope-sized pulsing black veins that tie it to the floor below.  The whole thing is shuddering constantly, and gives off an otherworldly stench.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

Small, nasty glass cannon spawning in groups  WP: mandible, leg
data.description: An small, flat creature dashing around erratically on seven short legs.  Its form is dominated by an oversized set of black mandibles on an almost comically small head, featureless apart from a single, black eye.  The rest of the body is covered with sickly white skin crisscrossed by black veins.
An inflated white body carried by five dainty legs, waving its remaining two limbs constantly.  Each one is tipped by a head-sized compound eye, independently scanning the horizon for prey.

A gangly creature running on six legs, its form made irregular by the green pustules at the limbs' base, each feeding into a large vein leading to two blackened claws.  What must have been a seventh leg fused with the creature's head forming a jagged proboscis emerging from below its eyes, dripping a caustic liquid.

A four-legged white creature about the size of a human, running with a decidedly feline gait, the three remaining limbs holding an almost-translucent skin membrane outstretched on its side and rear.  Much of its head is taken up by a beak like a raven's, which opens to reveal a set of jagged black teeth.

A short, crablike creature waddling around on six multi-jointed legs, its body dominated by a large glowing organ bulging from between the white armor plates.  A single raised appendage connects to the mass, its tip surrounded by brilliant white sparks.

special_attacks.monster_message: A cloud of electricity explodes from the %s
A bolt of electricity arcs from %s!

data.description: A large, thickly armored creature built not unlike a bear, if a bear had a long, clubbed tail and two short limbs ending in black talons framing a vertical mouth on an otherwise smooth, featureless head.  On second thought, not that much like a bear at all.

A diminutive humanoid figure, its body ravaged by fire into a blackened, charred shell.  Its leathery flesh has mended in patches, and the tattered clothing is still clinging to its emaciated frame making it clear it once was - and still is - the body of a child.
A charred zombie covered with bony plates, spikes, and protrusions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.
A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its flesh has mended into a leathery shell.
A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its flesh has mended into a leathery shell.  This one appears to have metal fragments sticking out of its body.
A charred zombie covered with bony plates, spikes, and protrusions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.  This one appears to have metal fragments sticking out of its body.
This horrifying little mutated wretch looks to have once been a child, but its massive gaping jaws are now far more suggestive of a predatory beast.
data.//grab: Half as grabby as a base zombie
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard-pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

death_drops.//: default zombie children clothing (always), additional items from child_items_pockets (sometimes)

data.description: What was once a child has bent and twisted into a bloated carcass with blackened skin and massive bloodshot eyes
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This heavily mutated child zombie twitches and flails its limbs in painful-looking spasms as it runs about.
This swollen, gooey-looking mutant child looks bad, even for a zombie.  Maybe that's why it seems to want a hug so badly.
data.//grab: Half as grabby as a base zombie

data.description: This crouching child-mutant's face is dominated by a pair of huge milky eyes, and its fingertips end in sharp claws.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: Undeath has not been kind to the children of the apocalypse.  This one is little more than a reanimated membrane of skin stretched across tiny brittle bones.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: Once a child, this hideous mass of sagging flesh and writhing organs twitches feebly as its midsection churns.  The ribcage has arched outward, forming a hive-like construct covered by severely stretched epidermis.  Bulging through the taut abdominal flesh, something squirms as if trying to break free.

special_attacks.monster_message: Ripping and tearing, a small beast burrows free of the wretch's abdomen!

data.description: A strange zombie covered in bone plates from face to toe.  Despite the added weight on its body, its movements are coordinated, almost as if capable of analyzing your movements.

data.//: This corpse looks like it could get up and start walking at any moment.
data.trigger_message_u: A zombie rises from the ground!
data.trigger_message_npc: A zombie rises from the ground!

data.description: You should not see this.  Causes loud noise.
data.//: volume is damage/3, so 8 to 20

data.description: You should not see this.  Causes all dormant corpses in the tile to revive.
A huge beast covered in visible scarring from the lightning bolts that arc out of its body.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.
A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

This zombie is visible only as a glowing white silhouette that you have to squint to see, cloaked in a crackling field of lightning that pulses like a beating heart.  It walks slowly and deliberately, the thunderstorm surrounding it eagerly jumping to anything conductive within its grasp.
data.//: slow walk speed - intimidating!
data.//2: melee damage is quite weak since the shockfield around it is its most dangerous function

data.description: A very pale dead body with the worst case of static hair you have ever seen.  Sparks of electricity frequently jump off it, lighting it up in the dark.  You might not want to touch it with your bare hands, or anything conductive.
data.//grab: Basic zombie level, the later versions lose grab in favor of lightning

data.description: A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief and layered in rolls of fat.  It emits a horrible odor, and a putrid sludge dribbles from its mouth.
This zombie has bloated well beyond human size, as though inflated by the putrid goo overflowing from its gullet.
A massively bloated zombie that has either been chugging gasoline or making biofuel in its distended gut; fumes and flames escape from its mouth and liquid petroleum leaks from its waddling form.
With its gray skin swollen to near-rupture with putrid gas, this cyst-covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.
A zombie swollen with a bluish, oddly sweet smelling gas.  It stumbles around even more than regular zombies, as if heavily intoxicated.
A bloated corpse, its ballooning skin blistered and rashy and its face caked in mucus.  The off-color orange gas that occasionally leaks from it makes your eyes water and smells faintly of pepper.

data.name: boomer glutton
data.description: A large, grotesque ball of flesh and fat.  Seemingly vestigial limbs flop around haphazardly as it rolls across the ground.  You occasionally catch a glimpse of bulging eyes and a distended gaping maw oozing some sort of black sludge.

data.name: bombardier boomer
data.description: This zombie's exposed ribcage is encircled by swollen lungs and other organs.  You would prefer to be far away when they burst.
A zombie like any other, but there's a strange feeling in the air around it.  Bits of black dust and small metal objects stick to it like magnets on a fridge.

A zombie surrounded by a whorl of black dust - iron filings, held in a magnetic storm that surrounds it like a hurricane.  It drags bits of metal along with it as it goes, and periodically, the area around it shimmers and warps as if seen through a distorted lens.

A zombie impaled with a multitude of metal fragments, each covered with a thick layer of rust that seems to propagate to other parts of its body.  You can't remember the last time you got a tetanus shot, so it would be best not to let this thing touch you.
Jagged fragments of rust-bitten metal have fused into this zombie's flesh and displaced parts of its spine.
Ruptures in this zombie's skin expose fragments of metal arranged like armor underneath.  Black sludge can be seen in places where the rust has receded.
A spiked horror of a zombie covered in long, rusty spikes.  A walking tetanus infection waiting to happen.
This brute of a zombie is covered in rusted metal detritus.  Chunks of metal smashed through its arms have deformed them into hammers.

Several workers died beneath a cascade of molten slag, their bodies shriveling and contorting together under the unimaginable heat.  The metal cracked and cooled, but they did not stay dead.  Still largely encased in their mineral prison, revivified muscle and bone now drag the lumpen mass along on four ungainly limbs that must have once been human beings.

A tangle of security personnel fused with their gear and with each other, warped limbs and flesh-covered equipment moving in strange unison.  Every so often you glimpse a pitch-black figure at its center, limbs mirroring the movements of the larger mass.

death_function.message: The creature grows sluggish before freezing in place for a moment.  Suddenly its flesh turns black and recedes to coat the central figure, which reaches out towards you before collapsing into a pinprick of shimmering air.  Torn uniforms and other gear tumble to the ground.

data.description: A great tendril of mutated flesh and sharpened bone.  Emerging from a crevice in the ruined floor, hundreds of human limbs seek freedom and writhe incessantly from underneath its grotesque carapace.  As enormous as it may be, you feel certain that this is just part of a much bigger creature, for when it moves, you can feel this whole ruin tremble, as though an unseen giant is struggling against the weight of its concrete tomb.

Covered in grievous wounds, this wretch's gray skin has bloated to near-rupture with putrid gas.  Between lumps of unrecognizable gore, a human head lamely follows your movements with empty, black eyes.
A nightmarish, spidery abomination born from human gore.  It deftly crawls between the walls and ceiling with limbs grown from its own disjointed ribs.
A corpse hideously twisted into an insect-like form.  A hollow tendril reaches out from its open thorax.
A nightmarish spider of gore standing tall among the ruins, keeping silent watch of the blighted landscape.  Its spindly limbs of bone slip between the rubble with otherworldly speed.
Great snakes of flesh hang from the ceiling above, madly thrashing and reaching about.
data.//grab: High weight ratio since it's not *really* 81kg

data.description: A great pile of merged bodies and mutated flesh.  It spasms in an arrhythmic and desperate manner.
A great lump of mutated flesh.  It resembles the innards of some gigantic creature, and is covered in a grid of diminutive veins.
The remaining protective gear, laboratory equipment, and long, formerly white labcoat tell you that this zombie was some kind of researcher before turning.
data.//: zombie scientists are recognised as friendly by the lab's defense system

data.description: A shambling human corpse wearing a gray uniform and a bulletproof vest with "SECURITY" emblazoned across the front.  It looks like this guard was quite physically fit before its death; it moves quickly and powerfully, albeit clumsily.
data.//: guards are recognised as friendly by the lab's defense system

data.description: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It walks and stumbles in a stuttered manner, and is granted tenuous corporality only by grace of the experimental gear it wore when it died.

special_attacks.monster_message: The skulker shifts and melts inwards before disappearing!

data.description: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It unnaturally skitters on four bone-plated spikes, its every motion trailing an aura of energetic distortion.

special_attacks.monster_message: The shrike shifts and disappears amidst an electric surge!

data.description: A hypothetical frog of the zombie variety.  You should not be seeing it without debug.

data.description: The only resemblance this creature bears to a tadpole is its slick black-green skin and slender body.  Its three appendages, resembling long tentacles or pseudopods, propel it across the ground at maddening speed.  It has no outward sensory organs or a mouth, and steam rises from its skin as if it is burning away its own lifeforce to catch you.
The wound covered skin of this large bullfrog appears to be peeling in places.  Its vacant stare passes by anything that isn't food, and it will leap to devour anything it can.

This gigantic zombified frog lets out an ear splitting unholy wail as it slowly takes notice of you.  Its mostly lethargic movements are offset by its ability to leap great distances using its gargantuan stout legs.

data.description: A distorted and swollen human body.  Its jaws have elongated into a crocodile-like snout, dripping with foul-smelling saliva.
A zombie like any other, except that at some point it suffered a catastrophic head injury.  Blind and deaf, it still gropes mindlessly for something to attack.
data.//2: Weight and volume reduced to reflect missing head parts.  Based on average headsize/weight, but are not exact.
data.//3: Lower hp to reflect previous damage.  Plus they're virtually useless so might as well make them a quick kill.

data.description: This headless zombie has stretched out to frightening proportions, towering almost nine feet tall.  Feelers which may have once been severed arteries and ligaments sprout from its neck, extending the length of a man's body like horrible antennae, quivering in response to the slightest sound.
data.//: the headless horror is technically blind, but its feelers allow it to sense your presence if you're close to it

data.description: This zombie's entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.

A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  With popping and cracking sounds its arm muscles constantly lengthen and contract as it reaches out with deformed muscular hands the size of dinner plates.
Somehow, this brute hides in the dark like some kind of boogeyman.  It is very agile for such a large zombie.

Enveloped in darkness is the outline of what used to be a person, quick and spindly - and nigh invisible in the shadows.  Even with the unnatural camouflage hiding its features you can make out large teeth and even larger claws.
A hulking zombie swollen to the size of six men.  Its dead-white eyes are locked on you.  No matter how far you run, it always seems to find you.
A badly deformed zombie.  Its arms dangle from its sides like the limbs of some skinless ape, mindlessly groping at their surroundings.
This zombie's elongated arms drag along the ground as it moves.  It looks to almost have a hunchback from the swollen shoulder muscles tearing though its skin.

This zombie's hollow black eyes survey its surroundings as it stretches and bends in ways that whoever the original body belonged to never could.  The only things that seem solid on this flexible, black-veined body are the rows of sharp, black teeth.  You get the feeling that the only human thing remaining is the skin, worn as one might wear clothes.
A human corpse swollen to the size of six men, with arms as wide as trash cans.
You're barely able to believe this thing was ever human; it scrambles about on all fours, its nails and teeth sharpened into dangerous-looking spikes.
data.//: Legs are important to this monster as he needs them to climb and leap.

data.description: This zombie's elongated head is nearly entirely given over to a crocodilian maw full of daggerlike teeth.

This zombie's features have tightened, its lips pulled back into an unnatural grin, revealing rows of blackened teeth beneath large, piercing eyes.  It stands tall and its movements are fluid and tightly controlled.  A feeling of danger permeates the surrounding air, and the light that falls on it seems somehow harsher and more glaring.

A twisted mockery of the human form, emaciated, with jet-black skin and glowing red eyes.  It is somehow painful to look at, awakening fears deep within your psyche, and even the surrounding air seems more sinister, somehow darker and more dangerous.

At first this creature looks like nothing more than a grotesque and oleaginous husk, bloated and punctured by jet-black pustules.  When approached, its glowing red eyes and an aching grin take form; its skin tears and its guts teem with unmatched fecundity, as its gaze inspires fear of nothing less than cosmic, inhuman ecstasy.

death_function.message: The %s lets out an unholy screech, and the corpses around it stir.

data.description: This recently-risen body moves quickly, darting its head back and forth and gnawing at its hands.

A hairless zombie.  Its pale, pinkish flesh appears to be squirming and moving across its body, quickly covering and fixing any wounds that it receives.  Its clothing is riddled with holes, suggesting someone else tried, and failed, to take it down.

With its joints in odd places and angles, this humanoid creature prowls across the landscape with surprising speed.  Its teeth and arms are sharpened into fine points, and greasy putrescence constantly seeps from its shredded skin.
A thin corpse, its chest swollen in what appears to be preparation.  Its filmy eyes bulge, seeking threats with a nervous energy not commonly seen in the undead.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human-shaped outline.
An elongated human body with a swollen chest and a gaping hole where its jaw used to be.
A blackened and twisted naked human body.  Strips of flesh hang from its frame, and it emits a constant haze of thick, stinking smoke.

A gigantic, twisted human frame with a menacing stance and rapid movements.  Thick clouds of smoke pour from violent-looking eviscerations spread across its muscular body, and its arms appear to have elongated massively.
A zombie that must have died in or near water judging by its pallor and swollen, waterlogged state.
A slick and glistening human body, face and belly bloated from what must have been a watery death.  Its hands and feet are elongated and webbed, suggesting some kind of rapid aquatic evolution.
data.//grab: Tier 2 mob, but webbed hands don't sound very grabby

data.description: Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.
This zombie's face, hands, work clothes, and miner's helmet are fully covered with stains of coal dust.

A shambling undead humanoid, its body overgrown with a tangled mass of otherworldly vegetation.  Hunched over and dragging its feet as it moves, the bramble utterly enveloping its upper half twitches and moves with a life of its own, tendrils tipped with a paralytic sting.
This shambling corpse is dressed in the tatters of an antiquated soldier's uniform.  Either it was a historical reenactor, or zombies have also started to time travel.
Apparently this zombie was doing time when the Cataclysm struck.  It wears black and white striped prisoner clothes, and tattoos can be seen on its decaying skin.
This muscular zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.
This fat zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.
This tough-looking zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.

A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombie's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Pus seeps from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the surrounding air.

data.//: Skelly brute gaps the evolution between normal and the juggernaut.
data.description: Distorted outgrowths of calcified bone plates cover this zombie's rotten skin.  Joints and cracks around its body ooze with pus.
Heavy, jagged bone plates have grown out of the surface of this zombie's skin.  Underneath, its flesh glows and crackles with the occasional jolt of electricity.

This hideous golem of plated bones and misshapen flesh drags its heavy, pointed limbs behind it like an unwanted burden.  Formerly soft and vulnerable, bones grew around its form to protect it - only, they kept growing.  And growing.  And growing.
Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.
This soldier zombie's skin radiates a sort of shadowy smoke that obscures its outline, making its camouflage even harder to see against the background.  In the darkness it would be nigh invisible.
Fragments of visible uniform hint that this monstrosity was once a soldier.  Anything human is invisible, hidden inside a sheath of living shadow.  It moves with preternatural fluidity and grace.

This staggering soldier wears a burnt gasmask, now fused to its face.  Through the melted, bile-encrusted ruination of the mask protrudes some sort of hardened, fleshy proboscis, with steaming corrosive fluid leaking from the end.

This zombie wears what appears to have once been a soldier's uniform and armor, now a series of cracked and melted plates that have fused to its skin and thickened hide.  It's riddled with wounds that might have once been bullet holes, puckering and drool an acrid slime.

This zombie dons a uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  Peculiarly, the uniform seems to have fused to its skin in certain places, its flesh gripping the edges of its gear as though the body were trying to absorb it.

This zombie was once wearing some kind of uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  At this point it's impossible to tell what kind of uniform it was: the monster's skin has grown over the fabric, splitting and tearing it to shreds, turning the remaining Kevlar and other bits of armor material into part of its hide.  Its hands have similarly fused into large, leathery cudgels.

This zombie was once wearing some kind of now long-shredded uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  It has grown into a hulking, leatherbacked beast, its mutated skin taking on a strange texture similar to the Kevlar bits embedded in it.  Its arms have twisted into enormous clubs of misshapen bone that it drags on the ground behind it.
Once a pilot, it is wearing a flight suit and a sturdy-looking flight helmet.  The head twitches and adjusts constantly, following any and every source of movement.
data.//: flight suits are made of nomex.

data.description: This undead soldier is adorned in standard military fatigues.  It carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.
Still dressed in the ragged remains of deep blue naval fatigues, it's clear that this walking corpse was once a sailor of some description.
data.//: no provision for body armour or helmets in either the weak point set or dissection set, as Navy sailors aren't normally dressed in military combat gear whilst shipside.

data.description: Dressed in the shredded blue dress uniform of a naval officer, this undead corpse was evidently a higher ranking crewman in life.  Having more than likely not been clad in body armor, the result now staggers before you: horrific wounds exposed to the air and large portions of flesh and muscle ripped from its glistening skeleton.
Dressed head to toe in naval combat equipment and with Marine insignia embroidered on its gear, this lurching corpse still retains its physical fitness in death.

Lumbering about on all fours, this mutated beast's dagger-like claws clack against the ground as it predatorially moves: thick strands of exposed muscle tissue running across its rotting body.  The addition of its new bulk has caused the skin along its arms and back to split, and the brute's teeth have extended into spikes of bone.  The Marine insignias on the remains of the creature's pulverized gear are the only testaments to the soldier that this hulking abomination used to be.

data.//: This is a variation which will drop default military equipment, rather than specific naval uniforms and gear.
data.description: Lumbering about on all fours, this mutated beast's dagger-like claws clack against the ground as it predatorially moves: thick strands of exposed muscle tissue running across its rotting body.  The addition of its new bulk has caused the skin along its arms and back to split, and the brute's teeth have extended into spikes of bone.  The military insignias on the remains of the creature's pulverized gear are the only testaments to the soldier that this hulking abomination used to be.
This walking corpse is dressed in high-end tactical gear .  It jerks mechanically as it moves, as though something was merely puppeting the corpse.
Once a highly-trained soldier, this zombie is still equipped with heavy military gear and dangerous physical abilities.  It moves with mechanical precision despite its undead state.
Still wearing the tattered remnants of improvised armor and weaponry, it is plain to see that this zombie was once a survivor like you.

Wearing military surplus gear including an armored vest with patches of local militias, cartoon women, obscene statements, or local political groups.  This person definitely thought they were ready for the apocalypse.

This zombie once was a survivor like you, and a pretty good one at that.  Unfortunately they didn't make it, despite the custom-made, heavy armor pieces they wear and the gear that they are still lugging around.
