mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "You're gonna rot in hell for this!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "You're gonna rot in hell, you pieces of shit!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "How long have you been in here?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "So, what is this thing supposed to be, exactly?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It was just wandering around by the freeway.  It might have been hit by a car."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "A fisherman hauled it in.  Lucky for us, he called the coast guard.  Yeah, I'd hate to be him right about now."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "I asked Dr. Fleischmann that same question and he said, 'You'll have to be more specific.'  This place, I swear…"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Yeah, they talk.  But it's just like, pre-recorded."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Maybe.  Except they repeat things they've never heard before."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "They found it in a downed craft, barely alive.  It's not the first one, either."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Area nineteen has a few in cold storage."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "We're still trying to figure out what makes it tick."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "We're not even sure what it is."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_surgeon
data.sound: "The cell structure is unlike any we've ever seen."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It's capable of complex problem solving.  It's clearly not just an animal."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Other than the mimicry, they have not responded to any of our attempts to communicate."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It's almost like they can't tell we're trying to talk to them, or maybe they just don't care."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "If I was in there I'd sure as hell be trying to talk my way out, but it's just standing there."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Mimicry in nature is usually to get close to prey or deter predators, but…"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Members of the species have some capacity to transmit information over long distances."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "This one's repeating phrases that the previous specimen was exposed to."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "To what end?  We've tried repeating the phrases back, to establish any kind of rapport.  Nothing."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "No, we can't go in there.  It would tear us apart."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "This one's repeating phrases that the previous specimen was exposed to."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "You mean it's not just parroting us?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It's parroting us, but we're uncertain as to how or why."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It may be a mechanism for attracting prey."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It could even be a way of trying to scare us off."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_surgeon
data.sound: "We have no idea what it's thinking, or even if it's thinking."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Why doesn't it just break the glass?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It tries to open the door a few times an hour."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "That fuckin' thing is horrible, man, it gives me the creeps."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It's probably more scared of us than we are of it."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "At least we know they can die."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "To be kept in a standard biohazardous containment chamber."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Until such time as more permanent arrangements are made."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Kill 'em all and let God sort 'em out!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "This is the way the world ends."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Look at this fuckin' shit we're in, man."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "That's the first time it moved all morning."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "I'm not convinced it can actually comprehend us."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "We've tried pictograms, gestures, audio, chemical signals.  It doesn't respond to anything we do."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Just being an alien creature doesn't mean it's intelligent."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Just because it doesn't look like you doesn't mean that it isn't."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It could be some kind of a drone."

speaker: mon_mi_go

mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_abductor
mon_mi_go_myrmidon

data.description: Your mission required you to eliminate a certain high-ranking individual in hiding.  Your mark seems to have turned feral while escaping and the world appears to be ending, but not even that can stop you from finishing your mission.
Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.
Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.
Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.
You're not sure who orders takeout when the world's ending, but that doesn't matter.  You have one final order to deliver.  The network is down, but you still have the address.
Live your life to the fullest, prove to yourself that you can survive this new obstacle in the same way that you have survived the last.
Become the best clown, make sure that your next show will make everyone laugh by training your social skills to perfection.

name.str: Find a memory of your master

data.description: Find and wield a whip to remember your master even when separated.
You could have become a master in martial arts if you had the chance, so train until you achieve the level of a master in the old world.
The world has ended, but as an authentic samurai you lack a katana, you must find one, quickly.
When you were escaping an evacuation point that was overrun, you had to leave your rifle behind.  Shame on you, what's a hunter without their hunting rifle?  You have to find one immediately.

You have saved your dogs from the fall of the world, but they could still suffer from danger everywhere.  Police dogs used some Kevlar harnesses for protection…  Maybe your friends could use some too?
The end of the world could have arrived, but you still crave for that one big hunt.  Search and kill a black bear to remember the old days.

The world has become like an anime!  Zombies, mutants, the end of civilization as we know it…  You must become the protagonist if you want to survive, the plot armor will help you.  Go and kill 50 zombies to show your protagonist potential.
They wanted to put you behind bars, but are now dead, make them pay with blood, unliving blood.
Go and recruit 3 followers, and maybe you'll be able to survive together.
You are a skater at heart, and as such you need some skates to drive by, any kind will suffice.
You need to always dress in style and fashion.  Find a gown or tuxedo for your personal use.
As a Game Master, it's just unacceptable that you now lack your means to play.  Find any tabletop game to play with any survivors you could find, even a cards game will suffice.
Survive all day from the crazy inhabitants of the mansion.
You were flying towards a nearby private airport before your forced landing.  You could still reach it by ground, and scavenge it for fuel.
Your helicopter was crashed to the ground, communications were lost with ground base, and the rest of your team died while landing, at least you still know the way back to the base.
Your bird is now on the ground, never again able to fly, you could search for a new one in the closest refueling stop requisitioned by the military.
Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it but never truly escape it.  It won't end until one of you dies.

A compact, structured sidebar. Ideal for playing with large font size or small resolution.

Features compact body graphs for HP, encumbrance, status and temperature.

Highly customizable in-game!

(It is recommended to disable sidebar spacers under Options -> Interface.)

generic_guns.name: Generic Guns
generic_guns.description: Replaces guns and ammo with generic types.  Warning: can cause issues with other gun mods.

gun_control.name: Gun Control
gun_control.description: WIP mod that greatly reduces the presence of guns in the game.  You might find a bit of ammo here and there, but firearms are extremely rare.

limb_wip.name: Work in Progress Limb Stuff
limb_wip.description: A repository for the in-progress Limb Project, containing all JSON-defined limb content for dedicated testing (and limit breakage for players who don't want to be on the bleeding edge).  Things might not work properly, so please report any limb-related weirdness on GitHub!

megacity_mod.name: Megacity
megacity_mod.description: The world is entirely covered by a single, unending city.  NOTE: Expect long load times!

megafauna.name: Megafauna
megafauna.description: Adds extinct pleistocene megafauna to the game, replacing modern day and introduced animals.

Mythos-Creatures.name: Mythos Mod - Mythos Creatures Only
Mythos-Creatures.description: Removes all the zombies (including fungus zombies), cyborgs and robots from the game and replaces them with a variety of Lovecraftian monsters - intended to be part of a total conversion mod but can be used as a standalone if wanted.

Only_Wildlife.name: No Monsters
Only_Wildlife.description: Removes all monsters from the game, save for those in the WILDLIFE category.

skyisland.name: Sky Island
skyisland.description: Note: This is an outdated version of TGW's mod and may cause issues until we are able to get it updated.  Use with caution!  An attempt at an entirely new way to play CDDA, inspired by games like Escape from Tarkov and Dark and Darker.  Begin on a floating island in the sky and warp down to random spots on the earth below to conduct expeditions for items you need.  Permadeath is gone - you will return to the island on death but lose any items you had on you.  Build up your stockpile, carry out missions for unique rewards, customize your home island, unlock upgrades, and be prudent about what you take on any given outing.  Be aware that 'PLAY NOW' will NOT work, you MUST make a custom character.

alt_map_key.name: Alternative Map Key
alt_map_key.description: Changes the overmap to be more readable.  Buildings are color coded by type and use initial letter of their names instead of ^v<>.

cbm_slots.name: Bionic Slots
cbm_slots.description: Enables the bionic slots system, which limits the number of CBMs you can install in each bodypart.

classic_zombies.name: Dark Days of the Dead
classic_zombies.description: Turns the game into a classic Romero zombie game.  You must destroy the brain.  Getting bitten is fatal.  However, zombies don't evolve, and when they're down, they're down.  Removes the sci-fi and interdimensional aspects of CDDA.

deadly_bites.name: Deadly Zombie Virus
deadly_bites.description: Bites from zombies have a chance to inflict a permanent fatal illness.  Find and consume antivirals to stave off the disease.

innawood.name: Innawood
innawood.description: An untouched land that mankind has yet to reach.  Disables most traces of civilization for that 'innawood' experience.

railroads.name: Railroads
railroads.description: Enables basic railroad network generation in the world.  <color_red>Not intended for regular gameplay, more for development purposes.</color>

tlg.name: The Last Generation
tlg.description: Core content for Cataclysm-TLG.  The game will probably not function without this enabled.
